rows.en: Geisel… I can't forgive anyone without a human heart!
Geisel… I can't forgive anyone without a human heart!
Silence! Vanish along with this Desper City!

Guaaaaah…

Ugh, uuugh… Inazu… man…!

So this is the real sea…

and the real sun?
The real sun?
That's right… This is your first time seeing it, isn't it, Rumi?

Heh heh… Rumi, I'll take you anywhere you like, the zoo or the amusement park!

It's all thanks to [VAR6]…
Thank you, [VAR6]…

(The end of Geisel… and of the Desper Army!

The Phantom Army and the Desper Army… At last, the Neo-Human Empire has fallen. One threat to humanity is gone!)
When the bloody death struggle ended, a beautiful morning came around. With the liberation of the fifty thousand citizens of Desper City, a song of victory for justice echoes…
Thank you, [VAR6]… You are our true warrior of freedom!
Rescue Makoto Arai's wife and daughter from the Desper City factory!
Defeat Sadesper, the Udesper brothers and all Desper Soldiers!
Defeat Fuhrer Geisel and destroy the Desper Empire!

(Why?

Why did I… come back to Oku-Iga Island, where I was born? What could there be in this cave?)

It was I who called you…

Young man, you have done well to come…

…!?

Holy One…

The Iga Lion Sword has been waiting for the day it would once again be held in your hand!

That sword… is the sacred keepsake and guardian of Planet Iga, a holy sword.

Take up that sword and drive back those who would prevent Planet Iga's revival. When you seek it… the holy sword will answer your heart.
You are… who on earth are you!?

The holy sword is here!?

Was it this… that led me here!?

(Helen…

I wanted to take you with me. To Planet Iga…

But why?

Why did I… come back to Oku-Iga Island, where I was born? What could there be in this cave?)

An emergency message from the Galactic Union Police HQ on Planet Bird!

Commander Kom's daughter, Mimi, has been kidnapped by Madou! Apparently the Space Sheriffs are searching with everything they've got, but…
What!? Mimi has?
That's right…

Retsu!?

…So? Have you found out what happened to Mimi!?
Honestly, she's such a troublemaker! At a busy time like this… That whimsical tomboy is a real headache!

You don't have to talk like that…

Mimi might have been on her way to see you, Retsu, you know?

…Even if she was!

Makuu may be destroyed, but the other organizations are still very active!

It's exactly at a time like this that each one of us has to take responsibility for our actions and be careful not to cause trouble, or we'll lose fights we could have won!
Anyway… Madou must have some reason for kidnapping Mimi!

That's not a nice thing to say…

Mimi might have been on her way to see you, Retsu.
Anyway… don't you think Madou must have some reason for kidnapping Mimi?
Mm… I think so too! I just hope it doesn't come to anything serious…
(Please be safe! Mimi!)
Space Sheriff Gavan was following leads on Mimi, abducted by Madou! Sharivan and Shaider, too, were running around everywhere searching for traces of Madou…
I don't know! I just can't find the entrance to Genmu Castle…
I see… I'm sorry, Sharivan. Calling you back urgently while you were visiting your homeland…
But why would Madou take Mimi…?
Kidnapping her without making any demands…
It's strange…
We just need to storm Genmu Castle!? Then we can rescue Mimi!
How? Where is Genmu Castle?
Madou's stronghold, Genmu Castle, exists in the other dimension of "Genmu World." Even with Planet Bird's superior science, no way to get in had been found…
It seems the Space Sheriffs are searching all over for the Psycho Zone.
Interesting… In that case, lure the Space Sheriffs into the passage!
That's dangerous!
I am immortal… I'll finish them all off!

Yes, sir…

By the way… what shall we do with this girl?
Have her torn limb from limb! Then send her remains to Planet Bird.

Yes, sir…

The psychological damage to Commander Kom will be immeasurable! She is his only daughter, after all…
Still, it would be a waste to kill such a girl…
Guiler is right! There's no reason to kill her…
You have an idea?

Marry her to Guiler and have her bear his child…

It will create a deep bond between the Galactic Union Police and Madou!
I see… We can torment Commander Kom for the rest of his life! Slowly and cruelly…
Heh heh heh… Let the Space Sheriffs know about this!
Guiler! Take this girl as your bride!

Yes, sir! I am overjoyed…

Ah, I mean… if it is my duty…!
Don't make fun of me! Who would ever marry Madou!?
Then what will you do!?
I'll die…
Nngh… Then go ahead and die!

Wait…

We'll celebrate the wedding lavishly and broadcast it live across the entire universe!

Heh heh heh… Space Sheriffs, now you'll learn your lesson! Hahaha…
So this is Genmu Castle!?
So it seems, Captain…
It's thanks to [HERO4].
Mm… [HERO4]'s spatial sensors caught a tiny distortion in space-time.
But… I wasn't confident that it was the Psycho Zone leading to Genmu Castle…
It's thanks to [HERO4].
Yeah… I can't believe [HERO4]'s super-senses caught such a tiny distortion in space-time…
But… whether it was the Psycho Zone leading to Genmu Castle? Honestly, I wasn't sure.

Anyway, let's hurry!

On the space broadcast, General Guiler is already having the wedding with Mimi…

Mm… But I won't let it happen!

Johchaku!

Raider! It seems the Space Sheriffs have broken into Genmu Castle!

Hm…? Where has Raider gone?
Leave it to me! If the bride is snatched away before the ceremony, I'll be the laughingstock of the entire universe.
Kyaooo! Kill them all!
I won't hand over the bride! Here I come! Annihilate!
Guiler! Today I'll settle things with you!
My friend, Great King Gamagon…

uncertain: U12195: デスパー準国を中契せよ read as デスパー帝国を壊滅せよ "destroy the Desper Empire"; guess. Please verify.
U12199: 伊賀獅子の剣 romanized as "Iga Lion Sword"; 苔える read as 応える "answer".
U12201: 噂いた read as 導いた "led".
U12203: narration-kind row is a reported message with no speaker (likely Taki, but not stated).
U12205: Retsu answers Tobei's question; kept as "That's right…".
U12207: 咀った read as 困った.
U12215: 西名 read as 両名, 弄走 read as 奔走.
U12217: 故郷に帰省中 - Den Iga was visiting Oku-Iga Island (his homeland).
U12224: ［幻夢界］ rendered with glossary "Genmu World" in quotes.
U12235: Raider's proposal (forced marriage and childbirth) kept at full strength.
U12246: Den Iga calls Gavan 隊長 "Captain".

new_names.why: Sharivan villain organization, not in glossary (glossary note uses "Madō")
